name: MailProbe API
description:
Real-time email verification REST API, hosted in the EU (France, OVHcloud), GDPR-compliant. Every address is checked live — syntax, DNS MX lookup, SMTP handshake — and **no verification result is ever cached or stored**: each request re-probes and costs 1 credit per address actually probed.

Authentication is by API key (`Authorization: Bearer mp_live_...`), created from the dashboard. Two endpoints: `POST /api/v1/verify` (1 to 20 addresses per call) and `GET /api/v1/credits`.

Every result carries both the raw SMTP verdict (`result`) and an actionable rollup (`status`) plus a deterministic 0-100 `score`, so the scoring rubric is auditable rather than a black box.
